question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 4 and 3360 respectively. If one of the numbers is 96, find the other one
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of numbers = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

Other number = (4 × 3360) ÷ 96

⇒ Other number = 3360 ÷ 24 = 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** = 4

**L.C.M.** = 3360

**First Number (n₁)** = 96

**Formula Used:**

n₁ × n₂ = H.C.F. × L.C.M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9b6c4c89e652cdc07b100081a5740578da11bf017cb40ef311a4e9d77622f1f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 96 × n₂ = 4 × 3360

⇒ n₂ = (4 × 3360) ÷ 96

⇒ n₂ = 13440 ÷ 96

⇒ n₂ = 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

H.C.F. (Highest Common Factor)

It is the greatest number that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder.

L.C.M. (Least Common Multiple)

It is the smallest non-zero common multiple of two or more numbers.

Relation for Fractions

H.C.F. of fractions = (H.C.F. of Numerators) ÷ (L.C.M. of Denominators).

L.C.M. of Fractions

L.C.M. of fractions = (L.C.M. of Numerators) ÷ (H.C.F. of Denominators).</p
